query: INSERT INTO odoo_user_links (user_id, odoo_url, odoo_db, odoo_login, odoo_uid, api_key_ciphertext, api_key_nonce) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET odoo_url = EXCLUDED.odoo_url, odoo_db = EXCLUDED.odoo_db, odoo_login = EXCLUDED.odoo_login, odoo_uid = EXCLUDED.odoo_uid, api_key_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.api_key_ciphertext, api_key_nonce = EXCLUDED.api_key_nonce, verified_at = NOW() RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS "inserted!"
